description: Returns WSF's fares for one ferry trip between two terminals on a date: every fare line item — passenger, senior and youth, vehicle and driver by length, motorcycle, bicycle, and multi-ride cards — with its amount in dollars, plus WSF's statement of which terminal collects which fares. Requires numeric terminal IDs — use wsdot_get_ferry_terminals to resolve terminal names to IDs; terminalPairs on wsdot_get_ferry_routes lists the pairs with service on a date, the same pairs wsdot_get_ferry_schedule accepts. WSF collects most fares in one direction only, so a line reads 0 on a leg whose departing terminal does not collect it: read collectionDescription before quoting a 0 as free travel, and query the reverse direction for where that fare is charged.

arrivingTerminalId.description: Numeric ID of the arriving terminal.

departingTerminalId.description: Numeric ID of the departing terminal. Use wsdot_get_ferry_terminals to look up terminal IDs.

roundTrip.description: When true, each amount is WSF's total for a round trip starting at the departing terminal: twice the one-way fare where both terminals collect it, the one-way fare where the return leg collects nothing, and the whole round-trip charge on a leg out of a terminal that collects nothing. Default: false (one way).

tripDate.description: Travel date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), the Pacific service day. Defaults to today if omitted.

name: wsdot_get_ferry_fares

collectionDescription.description: WSF's statement of which terminal collects which fares on this pair, e.g. "Passenger and vehicle/driver fares are collected at Anacortes, while no fares are collected at Friday Harbor." A fare the departing terminal does not collect reads 0 on this leg. Absent when WSF's statement could not be read, which the notice then reports.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSF Ferry API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The WSF Ferry API requests the call makes did not finish within its 50-second budget, retries included. `invalid_access_code`: WSF rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. `invalid_terminal_pair`: WSF lists no fares for the terminal ID pair on the trip date — the terminals have no direct service that day, or an ID is invalid. `invalid_date`: The tripDate is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date, WSF rejects it as outside the dates it has published fares for, or WSF lists no routes on it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fares.description: WSF's fare line items for this trip, in WSF's order, which groups them by category. Empty when WSF lists none, which the notice then reports.

items.description: One fare line item and its amount.

amountInDollars.description: WSF's fare in US dollars for the requested trip, passed through as given. 0 means WSF charges nothing for this line on this leg: on most pairs because the departing terminal does not collect it (collectionDescription says which terminal does), and for some lines, such as youth fares, because the fare itself is free.

category.description: WSF's grouping for the line: "Passenger", "Vehicle, Motorcycle, and Stowage Fares", or "Vehicle Length-Based".

description.description: The fare as WSF names it, e.g. "Vehicle Under 22' (standard veh) & Driver", converted from HTML to plain text with link destinations kept as "text (url)".

directionIndependent.description: True for a line WSF prices the same in either direction, such as a multi-ride card, which keeps its amount on a leg whose departing terminal collects nothing.

fareLineItemId.description: WSF's ID for this fare line.

notice.description: Present when WSF lists no fare line items for the pair, or when WSF's collection statement and the terminal names could not be read; says which.

roundTrip.description: Whether the amounts are WSF's round-trip totals (true) or one-way fares (false).

totalCount.description: Number of fare line items returned.

tripDate.description: Trip date the fares apply to (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific service day).

title: Get Ferry Fares
